_comment: The Pi Durable Platform mark (inner SVG markup on the 64 grid), from ../pdp-assets/logo/wake/. `svg` is mark-small.svg, the drawing for 20 to 47 px, used by components/logo.tsx (28 px, nav bar); `svgRegular` is mark.svg, the drawing for 48 px and up. Written by `npm run logo -- wake` (scripts/sync-logo.mjs), which also copies the favicons, icons and og-card into public/. If the logo changes, run it again, change the website's copy too, and commit.
